guard/30042.htm.text: Guard Abellos: Hello! My name is Abellos. For now, I am merely a guard here on this little island, but some day I may seek my fortune on the great continent across the sea. When I've saved enough money, I plan to buy a ticket to Gludio at the harbor .

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information

guard/30042-1.htm.text: Guard Abellos: You can take a regular liner to the mainland of Gludio. The boat fare is a little expensive, but your journey will be safe. To go to the harbor, follow the coastline west. If you want to take the boat, buy a ticket from the wharf manager Fallius.

Q00155_FindSirWindawood/30042-02.htm.text: Guard Abellos: You may have already heard about it, but this Talking Island is a part of Gludio territory. And Sir Collin Windawood is officially in charge of administration and public security on the lord's behalf. The lord personally appointed him Consul of this island. But now, it seems that the…

links.text: Say that you will help him.

Q00155_FindSirWindawood/30042-01.htm.text: Guard Abellos: You might know this already, but Talking Island is part of Gludio's lands. Currently, the person officially in charge of administration and order on the island is Sir Collin Windawood. The lord himself appointed Sir Windawood governor of this island. Well, I shouldn't be saying this.…

Q00155_FindSirWindawood/30042-04.html.text: Guard Abellos: Have you still not found Sir Windawood yet? I have a feeling that he might be near the Obelisk of Victory. You should try looking for him in that area first.

Q00155_FindSirWindawood/30042-03.htm.text: Guard Abellos: If you find Sir Windawood, please deliver this letter to him. I myself don't know exactly where he could be... According to the guard captain, he left the village two days ago, muttering something about wanting to visit the Ruins and the Obelisk of Victory ...
